programs.source:
match_lines=:3 :0
 cap=.y
 r=.0$a:
  for_k. i.Groups+1  do.
   if. k=0  do. prefix=.'match' else. prefix=.'group ',decimal k  end.
  'a b'=.((2*k)+0 1){cap
   if. (a<0)+.b<0  do. r=.r,<prefix,' -'
   else. r=.r,<prefix,' ',(decimal a),'-',(decimal b),' ',quote k capture_text cap  end.
  end.
 r
)
